# ADR-NNN: Decision title

Status: proposed / accepted / superseded

Owner, reviewers, date and source-lock revision:

## Trigger and contract

State the concrete implementation choice or conflict. Identify requirement IDs and affected profiles.

## Evidence

Link exact published/draft clauses, errata disposition, implementation evidence and tests. Distinguish normative text from examples, inferred intent and local policy. Use short quotations only where necessary.

## Options

| Option | Behavior | Compatibility/security cost | Validation needed |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| A | Fill in | Fill in | Fill in |
| B | Fill in | Fill in | Fill in |

## Decision

Specify behavior, defaults, limits and rejection/defer semantics. Explain why it satisfies the selected profile or why a gap remains. List any source conflict explicitly; do not hide it behind a feature name.

## Consequences and review trigger

List dependent agents/files, migration implications, tests to rerun and what future source revision or evidence should reopen the decision. Identify user judgment needed only if scope or product requirements materially change.
